Mass shooting at South African house party kills 11, injures 3

Police said three gunmen entered a house party in KwaMakhutha township, about 30 km south of Durban, forced victims into a single room and opened fire, killing 11 people-including a woman believed to be pregnant-and wounding three. Two people survived. The motive was not immediately clear.
